text: The truth of the matter is, that a captain who would keep the field, cannot decline battle when his adversary forces it on him at all hazards. So that the instruction to avoid battle is but tantamount to saying, "You shall engage when it pleases your enemy, and not when it suits yourself."
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
